verses: Qasam hai chasht kay waqt ki
Aur qasam hai raat ki jab cha jaye
Na to teray rab ney tujhay chora hai aur na woh beyzaar ho gaya hai
Yaqeenan teray liye anjam aaghaaz say behtar hoga
Tujhay tera rab boht jald (inam) dey ga aur to razi (o khush) ho jaye ga
Kiya uss ney tujhay yateem paa ker jagah nahi di
Aur tujhay raah bhola paa ker hidayat nahi di
Aur tujhay na-daar paaker toongar nahi bana diya?
Pus yateem per to bhi sakhti na kiya ker
Aur na sawal kerney walay ko dant dapat
Aur apney rab ki nematon ko biyan kerta reh
